title: Compliance Risk Radar and Cutover Backstop Plan for SOC2/SSO Rollouts
creator: Avery Chen
description: Define a lightweight, operational risk radar and a technical/business backstop plan for scheduled SOC2 and SSO/SAML cutovers. The goal is to reduce blast radius during tenant cutovers, improve cross-team runbooks, and provide an automated gating dashboard that surfaces pre-cutover signals (audit-log ingestion, SSO federation checks, config drift). This ticket coordinates PM/Eng/Security/Support runbooks + rollout thresholds for 4 upcoming customer cutovers.
milestones: 2026-03-05: Draft risk radar taxonomy (Availability, Integrity, Confidentiality, Latency, Auditability) — owner: Priya Kapoor
2026-03-12: Define automated preflight checks and thresholds (audit-log latency < 5s, SSO testauth pass rate > 99%) — owner: ENG oncall lead
2026-03-20: Build and validate cutover runbook (canary windows, escalation ladder, rollback criteria) — owner: Security Operations
2026-03-28: Implement dashboard widgets in Console + alerting hooks (PagerDuty + OpsGenie) — owner: Console eng
2026-04-10: Dry-run with staging tenant and simulate audit-log backlog scenario — owner: Reliability team
2026-04-20: Execute first production soft-cutover (limited tenants) with on-call shadow — owner: Release coordinator
acceptance_criteria: Risk radar dashboard shows live signal status for all scheduled cutovers in Console
Automated preflight checks halt cutover when any critical signal breaches threshold and create a blocking ticket
Runbook contains clear rollback steps, owner contact list, and SLA for decision windows (<= 30 minutes)
Two dry-runs completed and post-mortems documented with action items closed or scheduled
Stakeholder signoff from Security, Support, and Product before first production soft-cutover
blockers: ENG-92310: Missing SSO synthetic test harness for federated IdPs (blocked implementation of testauth checks)
Observability: audit-log ingestion metrics currently sample at 1m intervals; need 15s granularity for reliable gating
Oncall rotation gaps during April holiday week (needs temporary coverage plan from SRE)
decisions: Use a three-tier gating policy: green (auto-proceed), amber (manual approval), red (block + rollback). Approved 2026-03-10.
Thresholds set conservatively for first two cutovers: SSO testauth pass rate >= 99.5%, audit-log ingestion lag < 3s. To be relaxed after two successful runs.
Rollback strategy: immediate re-route to hosted fallback and tenant freeze; requires support-led customer notification template. Approved by Security on 2026-03-14.
notes: Trade-off: aggressive thresholds reduce risk but increase false-positive blocking; mitigation is to add amber manual approvals with a 30-minute decision SLA.
We will prioritize signals that are both high-signal-to-noise and actionable (audit-log lag, SSO synthetic auth, disk pressure on dedicated nodes).
Consider adding a lightweight tenant-level feature flag to opt-out of auto-cutover for high-risk customers; needs legal/CS review.
